product.name: BouncyBlox Stackable Building Blocks Set
product.description: The BouncyBlox Stackable Building Blocks Set offers a vibrant, tactile play experience for children aged three and up. Each block is crafted from durable, low‑toxicity PVC and features a smooth, rounded edge for safe handling. The set includes 120 blocks in a variety of shapes and colors, encouraging open‑ended construction and spatial reasoning. Blocks interlock securely yet can be easily separated, supporting repeated use and creative exploration. The packaging is recyclable and the design promotes fine motor skill development while providing a safe, non‑toxic alternative to traditional wooden blocks.
